xerox.name: Xerox
xerox.description: Xerox Holdings Corporation is an American company selling printers and digital document products worldwide. It pioneered the photocopier market with the Xerox 914 in 1959. The company is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, with its largest employee base around Rochester, New York.

xylem-inc.name: Xylem Inc.
xylem-inc.description: Xylem Inc. is a large American water technology provider headquartered in Washington, DC. It serves public utility, industrial, commercial, agricultural, and residential markets in over 150 countries. The company was launched in 2011 as a spinoff from ITT Corporation.

xlsmart.name: XLSmart
xlsmart.description: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk is an Indonesian mobile telecommunications operator headquartered in Jakarta. It is jointly owned by Malaysia-based Axiata and Indonesian conglomerate Sinar Mas. The company offers broadband services through 2G, 4G, 5G, and optical fiber networks under brands XL, Axis, and Smartfren.

xiabu-xiabu.name: Xiabu Xiabu
xiabu-xiabu.description: Xiabu Xiabu Catering Management Co., Ltd. is a fast food hot pot restaurant chain headquartered in Daxing District, Beijing, China. It operates in the restaurant industry within China.

xos-inc.name: Xos, Inc.
xos-inc.description: Xos, Inc. is an American manufacturer specializing in commercial electric vehicles and mobile EV chargers. The company operates in the automotive industry and focuses on electric vehicle technology.

xunlei-limited.name: Xunlei Limited
xunlei-limited.description: Xunlei Limited is a Chinese multinational technology company and online service provider founded in 2003. Its headquarters are in Nanshan District, Shenzhen. The company has a subsidiary named Shenzhen Xunlei Networking Technologies, Co., Ltd.

xinyi-glass.name: Xinyi Glass
xinyi-glass.description: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited is a public company based in Hong Kong, China, producing float glass, automobile glass, and construction glass. Established in 1988, it serves major automobile corporations and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2005.

xperi-corporation.name: Xperi Corporation
xperi-corporation.description: Xperi Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It develops software for consumer electronics and connected cars, and media platforms for video service over broadband, with brands including DTS, HD Radio, and TiVo.

xg-technology.name: XG Technology
xg-technology.description: Vislink Technologies, Inc., formerly xG Technology, is an American technology company specializing in live video and data management. Founded in Florida in 2002, it is headquartered in Hackettstown, New Jersey, with offices worldwide. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ.

xero-limited.name: Xero Limited
xero-limited.description: Xero Limited is a New Zealand technology company that provides cloud-based accounting software for small businesses. It operates on a software-as-a-service model and sells subscriptions based on the number and type of entities managed. The company has offices in multiple countries and its products are used in over 180 countries.

xinjiang-xinxin-mining-industry-company.name: Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Company
xinjiang-xinxin-mining-industry-company.description: Xinjiang Xinxin Mining Industry Company Limited is a major Chinese non-ferrous metals mining company headquartered in Fuyun County, Xinjiang. It is the second largest producer of electrolytic nickel in Mainland China and integrates mining, smelting, and refining for various strategic and rare metals.

xinyuan-real-estate.name: Xinyuan Real Estate
xinyuan-real-estate.description: Xinyuan Real Estate Co., Ltd. is a Chinese real estate company. The summary does not provide additional details about its operations or location.

xishan-coal-and-electricity-power.name: Xishan Coal and Electricity Power
xishan-coal-and-electricity-power.description: Shanxi Xishan Coal and Electricity Power Co., Ltd. was established in 1999 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2000. It operates 9 coal mines, 8 coal plants, and 13 holding companies.

x5-retail-group.name: X5 Retail Group
x5-retail-group.description: X5 Group is Russia's largest food retailer. The original organization of X5-Retail Group LLC was liquidated in 2012, and X5 Group LLC was opened in 2018.

xl-group.name: XL Group
xl-group.description: Axa XL is an American subsidiary of the global insurance and reinsurance company Axa. It is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, domiciled in Bermuda, and operates more than 100 offices worldwide.

xaar-plc.name: Xaar plc
xaar-plc.description: Xaar plc is a company based in Cambridge, United Kingdom, that supplies industrial inkjet printheads. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange.

xp-investimentos.name: XP Investimentos
xp-investimentos.description: XP Inc. is a Brazilian investment management company offering fixed income, equities, investment funds, private pension products, and wealth management services. It serves customers in Brazil and has offices in multiple international cities.

xuly-bet.name: Xuly Bët
xuly-bet.description: XULY.Bët is a luxury clothing line designed by Malian-Senegalese fashion designer Lamine Badian Kouyaté. It is a fashion brand associated with Mali.
